name: auth_users
description: Login, registration and profile endpoints: public routes must opt out of bearer auth.

input.title: Accounts API
input.requirements: Account management. Anyone can register with an email, a password (at least 8 characters) and an optional name, and can log in with email and password to receive an access_token and its expires_in (seconds). A signed-in user can read and update their own profile (name or password) at /users/me. Users have a role that is either member or admin, and an admin can fetch any user by id.
